title: First and second derivatives at t = 0 of √det(I − P + P A(t)* A(t) P) (Simon's printed second-order expansion)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let T ⊆ ℝᴺ be a linear subspace with orthogonal projection P := T.starProjection. Let (b_i)_{i∈ι} be an orthonormal basis of T indexed by a finite type ι, and let A : ℝ → L(ℝᴺ) (continuous linear endomorphisms of ℝᴺ) satisfy A(0) = I. Put j(t) := √det(I − P + P A(t)* A(t) P). (1) If A has derivative A₁ at 0, then j has derivative Σ_i ⟨b_i, A₁ b_i⟩ at 0. (2) Suppose A is differentiable at every point of some neighbourhood of 0, A has derivative A₁ at 0, and t ↦ deriv A t has derivative A₂ at 0. Then the function deriv j has derivative Σ_i ⟨b_i, A₂ b_i⟩ + (Σ_i ⟨b_i, A₁ b_i⟩)² + Σ_i ‖A₁b_i − P(A₁b_i)‖² − Σ_i Σ_k ⟨b_i, A₁ b_k⟩⟨b_k, A₁ b_i⟩ at 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ T) (A : ℝ → Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), A 0 = 1 → let j : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ Real.sqrt ((1 - T.starProjection + T.starProjection ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (A t) ∘L A t ∘L T.starProjection).det); (∀ A₁ : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, HasDerivAt A A₁ 0 → HasDerivAt j (∑ i, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₁ (b i : Rn N))) 0) ∧ ∀ A₁ A₂ : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, DifferentiableAt ℝ A t) → HasDerivAt A A₁ 0 → HasDerivAt (deriv A) A₂ 0 → HasDerivAt (deriv j) (∑ i, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₂ (b i : Rn N)) + (∑ i, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₁ (b i : Rn N))) ^ 2 + ∑ i, ‖A₁ (b i : Rn N) - T.starProjection (A₁ (b i : Rn N))‖ ^ 2 - ∑ i, ∑ k, inner ℝ (b i : Rn N) (A₁ (b k : Rn N)) * inner ℝ (b k : Rn N) (A₁ (b i : Rn N))) 0
